title: Mixed Event — As the Leaves Change Once More — Episode2 The Greatest Plan

meta.Event: As the Leaves Change Once More
meta.Event Outline: After the success at Jam Fest, Shiho is energized to practice. But Shizuku and Saki invite her on a day trip to relax and enjoy the fall foliage.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I'm glad I got off work early today.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Now I can go home and listen to the new CD I just bought.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Then I'll practice until it's time for dinner, and...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Doesn't Saki work over at that cafe?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (And I'm seeing some familiar faces in the window...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What are those three doing there together?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (From what I can see, they're not studying together or anything. They have a bunch of books and magazines laid out on their table...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I don't know what's going on, but if they see me, it's going to be a whole thing. I'll just pass by quickly...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (They saw me.)
carino/carina

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So, what are you guys doing with all these books and magazines?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I'm glad you asked!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We were just in the middle of planning the Tenma-Hinomori Leaf-Viewing Reattempt!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Reattempt? Oh, you mean our day trip.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, Saki said she could join in after her shift ended and asked us to meet here...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, the three of us have decided to plan our trip together.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: By the way, what do you guys have in mind at the moment?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're still brainstorming, but here are our notes!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: “Leaf-viewing followed by river rafting, lunch and a foot bath. Visit the art museum, have tea at a trendy cafe, visit the local shrine, climb a mountain and go fruit picking.”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Doesn't it all sound like so much fun?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, but... It's not going to be possible to do all these things in one day. Each of these places are pretty far apart, too, so that's gonna be a lot of time spent in transit...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, I had a feeling...
I was hoping that we could fit in a few extra activities with efficient enough routing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haha. We sorta couldn't help ourselves. We just kept finding all these great things to do...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Just take this magazine, for instance.
It gives all these recommendations and goes into so much detail.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, Tsukasa, check this out!
The rope bridge on this map looks really fun! It apparently creaks and wobbles like crazy!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, look at that!
And based on its height, it likely offers a spectacular view.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, let's add it to the list.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (This is bad. If I let these three handle everything, they won't have anything decided by the day of...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I have no choice.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: If you guys just keep adding to that list, then you're not gonna get anything done.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You won't be able to come up with a real plan if you keep cramming in more and more activities.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Urgh... Fair point...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You already have plenty on this list, so it's time to start narrowing down which are our most viable options.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Why don't we begin by coming up with the goal for this trip?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The goal...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Our primary goal is to see the leaves, right?
So, we should begin by picking where we're going to do that.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Then, we can start looking at other places to visit and activities to do. Wouldn't that help smooth out this process?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, that's excellent...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, then...
How about we go leaf-viewing on this mountain?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Look! It even says that now's the best time to see them!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and it's close enough that we can travel there and back by train.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, there's even a historical village nearby with old buildings and cafes, as well as a vineyard where we can pick our own grapes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Fall is all about bountiful harvests!
We must take this opportunity to go fruit picking, no?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: A historical village and fruit picking...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
We can visit both using a bus.
Why don't we add them to the list?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa...!
Our itinerary's coming together so fast!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you for doing this, Shii. We really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's use this momentum to keep hammering out the details of our trip!

rows.Speaker: Saki & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Okay! Does this itinerary look good to you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, let's just check over our route one last time.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: After arriving at the station, we'll explore the historical village. We'll take a quick break at this cafe and then go fruit picking.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Finally, we'll go leaf-viewing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow...!
We'll really get to do all the things we wanted in one day!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I'm excited to the max about this trip right now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, I'm looking forward to this trip as well! I know! Why don't we practice picking grapes at home?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Wait, practice picking grapes...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you again, Shii.
Thanks to you, I think we're in for a very fun trip now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's fine. Honestly, I was worried about what would happen if I left you three to your own devices...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Despite them saying that they'd take care of all the planning, I ended up doing most of the work.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (I can live with that.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: (It's not often that we get to take trips like this together, so I should try to enjoy myself when we go.)
